mapper.select: SELECT sc.scid, ua.username, sc.content, sc.created_at, sc.updated_at, (sc.user_id = #{userId}) AS is_mine FROM study_comment sc JOIN user_account ua ON sc.user_id = ua.user_id WHERE sc.isid = #{isid} ORDER BY sc.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_comment (isid, user_id, content) VALUES (#{isid}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM study_comment WHERE scid = #{scid}
mapper.update: UPDATE study_comment SET content = #{content} WHERE scid = #{scid}
